# Code of Conduct

This project is developed and maintained within the open-source **BoardPort** community.
All interactions within this repository (issues, pull requests, discussions) must remain
professional, constructive, and respectful.

---

## Expectations

- **Mutual Respect**: Communicate courteously and value each other's time and effort.
- **Constructive Communication**: Offer clear, actionable feedback and reasoned arguments.
- **Focus on Solutions**: Keep discussions centered on technical merit, code quality, and problem solving.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, trolling, personal attacks, or derogatory remarks of any kind.
- Spam, disruptive debates, or off-topic arguments.

## Contact

If you encounter inappropriate behavior in issues or pull requests,
please reach out directly to the maintainers at **BoardPort Team <boardport@proton.me>**.
